process_note: The sfnl-prompt-master skill is not available to this subagent, so the hunt followed the agent definition directly.
conviction_note: The findings sum to -0.5. Revenue probably misses a RMB1.93bn consensus that sits 3.9% above the guide top; the profit bar looks unreliable; peer prints were soft; and the name has sold off on beats. Against that, the stock went into the print down 19% over 20 days against KWEB's -7.7%, the price is 45% under the mean target, and the full-year consensus implies a Q4 bar that a typical guide clears. Those offset, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0 on an abs move of 7.5%. The scaled number differs from the findings sum because the de-rating is real but cannot be signed with confidence.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus is RMB1.93bn from two aggregators that agree on revenue: Chartmill (1.928B, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/GOTU/estimates, via search snippet) and FXEmpire (1.93B, https://fxempire.com/stocks/gotu/earnings). That is 3.9% above the top of the company's guide of RMB1,838-1,858m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001768259/000119312526369427/gotu-ex99_1.htm). Their EPS consensus of +RMB0.26 per ADS is doubtful: Q3 2025 had a non-GAAP net loss of RMB137.7m and Q2 2026 a loss of RMB0.54 per ADS. Findings that lean on the EPS bar are capped small. The full-year 2026 revenue consensus is RMB7.07bn (range 7.0-7.1bn, 4 analysts, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/gotu/forecast/), a single source, so the Q4-guide finding is capped.

next_guide.company_current_guide: None for Q4 2026. The company guides one quarter ahead; the current guide is Q3 2026 at RMB1,838-1,858m, +16.4% to 17.7% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001768259/000119312526369427/gotu-ex99_1.htm)
next_guide.basis: Deferred revenue at June 30 was up 18.9% and Q2 billings up 19.4%. Q4 2025 billings rose 19.1%, and the last four quarterly guides ran from +5.7% (the seasonal Q1) to +17.7%. A Q4 guide in the low-to-mid teens is therefore more likely than not, which would sit at or above the street's implied +6-12%. Q3 billings and Sept-30 deferred revenue are unknown, and management said unprofitable offline sites may be cut after summer, which tempers this.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue probably lands below the RMB1.93bn consensus. The consensus sits 3.9% above the guide top of RMB1,858m, and the guide (+16.4-17.7%) is close to June-30 deferred revenue growth (+18.9%, RMB2,611m) and Q2 billings growth (+19.4%). In Q2 the guide sat about 10 points below deferred growth (+24.1% at March 31) and the company beat its top by 4.5%. With that cushion now about 1-2 points, my central estimate is RMB1.88-1.91bn, a beat on the guide and a 1-3% miss on the consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: revenue RMB1,579.0m, at the guide top (1,558-1,578) but below a RMB1.61bn consensus, stock -8.05%. Q2 2026: beat consensus by 3.1%, stock +5.2%. Q1 2026: beat the guide top by 5.7% and still fell 10.36%, on profit and cash outflow. Q4 2025: beat the guide top by 2.3% and fell 8.72%, on a weak Q1 guide.
findings.why_not_priced: The aggregator consensus still reads 1.93bn. If the market had priced a 1.88-1.91bn print against it, the previews would quote a bar near the guide. The 20-day de-rating also tracks peers and KWEB (see the expectations finding), not a revenue revision.
findings.independence: Consensus from https://fxempire.com/stocks/gotu/earnings; guide-beat history from the Q3 2025 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1768259/000119312525298087/gotu-ex99_1.htm) and the Q4 2025 6-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1768259/000119312526092416/gotu-ex99_1.htm). The deferred-revenue reasoning is my inference from the same Q2 6-K.

findings.finding: The stock went into the print down 19.3% over 20 sessions and 13.2% over 5, against KWEB at -7.7% and -5.1%. It is 27% off its 2026-10-12 high of $2.84 and 45% below a $3.76 mean target. The market's real bar has fallen below the revenue consensus. The last time the company cleared consensus (Q2) the stock rose 5.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after a weak run and rose 5.2% on a consensus beat. Q3 2025 came in near $2.6 and fell 8.05% to $2.40 (https://www.itiger.com/news/2586209018).
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is priced by definition. The question is whether the bar in the price now sits below the stale 1.93bn consensus and the March-dated targets. Part of the drawdown is explained by peers (the New Oriental print day, -8.2%) and by the China tech sell-off (KWEB -8% over 2026-11-16 to 11-20), not by GOTU news, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: KWEB and TAL closes from https://www.quiverquant.com/stock/KWEB/historical-prices/ and https://www.quiverquant.com/stock/TAL/historical-prices/; targets from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/gotu/forecast/.

findings.finding: TAL's summer quarter (Jun-Aug 2026, reported 2026-10-29) grew revenue 15.5% in USD (about 9% in RMB), 8.7% below a $1.09bn consensus. The miss came mostly from learning devices; offline Peiyou enrolments grew double digits and online enrichment moderated, and management expects further moderation.
findings.link: Same K-12 enrichment and non-academic tutoring market and the same summer season. GOTU's non-academic tutoring is over 40% of revenue and grew 30% in Q2. GOTU sells no learning devices, which drove most of TAL's shortfall, so the link is the online-enrichment line only.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GOTU barely moved on TAL's print day (2.36 to 2.27, -3.8%, 2026-10-28 to 10-29) after falling 8.2% the day before on New Oriental's print.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public for a month and mostly priced. What is left is whether GOTU's online enrichment saw the same autumn moderation, which shows up in its Q3 billings and Q4 guide.
findings.independence: Revenue and consensus also at https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/TAL/2610294374. Net of the device segment, this is a weak signal.

findings.finding: New Oriental's Jun-Aug quarter grew revenue 23.1%, ahead of its full-year guide, but it held the FY guide at 14-18%, implying 11-16% for the rest of the year, and deferred revenue grew only 11.2%. The stock fell about 12% on 2026-10-28. The sector is selling forward deceleration, not reported beats.
findings.link: Same China K-12 enrichment and test-prep market and the same summer quarter. New Oriental is much more diversified (East Buy, overseas test prep), so the link is reaction function and demand tone, not shared revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GOTU fell 8.2% on 2026-10-28, New Oriental's print day, so it has traded in sympathy with this peer's guide signal.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, as the 2026-10-28 GOTU move shows. It is filed because it says the market punishes decelerating forward guides in this group, which matters for GOTU's Q4 guide.
findings.independence: Release at https://finviz.com/news/409725/new-oriental-announces-results-for-the-first-fiscal-quarter-ended-august-31-2026; GOTU's price on that day from quiverquant.

findings.finding: Youdao's learning-services revenue for the identical Jul-Sep 2026 quarter fell 5.2% YoY to RMB609.4m. The nine-month figure was +6.8%, so its summer quarter was its weakest.
findings.link: Same quarter and the same online learning services channel in China. Youdao's mix is digital content, adult and K-12 courses; GOTU's is live online and offline tutoring. No shared customers are stated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: GOTU fell 5.0% on 2026-11-19, Youdao's print day, and a further 9.6% on 2026-11-20, alongside KWEB -2.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, given the 2026-11-19/20 drop. It lands after GOTU last spoke (2026-08-27), so GOTU's consensus may not reflect it, but GOTU's own Q2 run-rate (+20%) is far stronger than Youdao's.

findings.finding: The Q4 2026 guide, GOTU's first statement on that period, is more likely than not to land at or above the street's implied Q4. The FY2026 consensus of RMB7.07bn less 9M revenue implies Q4 of RMB1.78-1.88bn (+6-12% on Q4 2025's 1,685.3m). GOTU's last three non-Q1 guides were +13.6-17.7%, Q2 billings grew 19.4%, and Q4 2025 billings grew 19.1%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide decides this stock. A weak Q1 guide (+5.7-7.0%) went with -8.72% on 2026-03-05; a Q3 guide of +16.4-17.7% with a beat went with +5.2% on 2026-08-27; a Q4 2025 guide of +17.2-18.7% went with -8.05% on 2025-11-26, when revenue missed consensus.
findings.why_not_priced: The full-year consensus comes from 4 analysts with targets dated March, so the implied Q4 is probably stale-low. If the market expected a mid-teens Q4 guide, the stock would not be trading 45% under the targets after a -19% month. Capped because the street figure is a single source, Q3 billings are unknown, and management said unprofitable offline sites may be cut after summer.
findings.independence: Guide history: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1768259/000119312526092416/gotu-ex99_1.htm (Q1 guide +5.7-7.0%) and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1768259/000119312525298087/gotu-ex99_1.htm (Q4 2025 guide +17.2-18.7%, Q3 2025 billings +11.2%). Site cuts: https://www.insidermonkey.com/blog/gaotu-gotu-narrows-its-losses-while-a-new-growth-question-emerges-1824497/

findings.finding: The aggregator EPS consensus for Q3 is +RMB0.26 per ADS, a profit. Q3 is a loss quarter for GOTU: the Q3 2025 non-GAAP net loss was RMB137.7m and the Q3 2024 net loss RMB471.3m. Q2 2026's loss narrowed by only about RMB78m YoY (opex +8.8%). At about +18% revenue and 66.5% gross margin, my estimate is a non-GAAP loss of roughly RMB50-90m, an optical EPS miss if that consensus is real.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: EPS missed (-0.57 against -0.46) and the stock still rose 5.2% on revenue. Q1 2026: the profit drop went with -10.36%.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS bar is probably a data artefact the market does not hold, so this is capped small. It matters only if wires headline an 'EPS miss'.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 loss from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1768259/000119312525298087/gotu-ex99_1.htm; Q2 opex from the Q2 6-K. Shares the consensus source with the revenue finding (FXEmpire).

That leaves about US$76.5m of the US$100m 2025 program by my calculation, against about RMB4.0bn of cash and investments. Buying slowed in 2026 (about RMB620m cumulative by 2025-11-25).

findings.why_not_priced: No new authorization or dividend has been announced. One with the print, at a price 27% below October, would be new, but that is speculation with no source, so it is sized small.

baseline_tension: No skew is available. The -19% 20-day run-up, against KWEB's -7.7%, points to a lowered real bar, which cuts against my mildly negative reported-quarter findings. That keeps p_up at 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; a proxy is smaller): expectations finding cut from +1.5 to +1.0, because part of the drawdown is explained by peers and KWEB and the rest has no cause.

Rule 6 (verify the bar): the Q4-guide finding rests on a single-source FY consensus, cut from +1.0 to +0.7; the EPS-bar finding was already capped and moved from -0.4 to -0.3 because that bar is doubtful.

Rule 9 (net of segment): TAL's miss was mainly devices, which GOTU does not sell, so TAL cut from -0.4 to -0.2; New Oriental's print beat and was sold on its guide, so it is a reaction-function signal, cut from -0.3 to -0.2; Youdao cut from -0.4 to -0.3.
Rule 8 (thin coverage, understatement) and the FPI reaction-history lesson: rebuilt the base rate from confirmed releases (median about 8% on the last four); abs_move_pct raised from 7.0 to 7.5.
Rule 3 (caveats reach the number): offsetting findings with no sourced deciding number, so p_up moved from 53 to 50 and expected_move from +0.42 to 0.0.
